title: Works well, but no improvement over other designs
text:
Works well, but no improvement over other designs. I love how compact this set is. However, you need to shake out the water after each use and let it dry, otherwise water will literally "jump" off it when you are replacing it into the receptacle. Of course, I have had to do that with other brands and designs as well, but this one is particularly touchy.

The brush itself does an excellent job of removing crud. The water where I live is heavy in minerals and leaves a hard deposit on the bowl. Most brushes take a lot of work to remove the deposit, whereas this brush does a more effective job.

I have not owned it long enough to assess how truly sturdy it is, but so far, so good in that respect.
